title: Spencer Grand Voyage 2026-2027 — Master Client & Trip Information Intake
documentTitle: Spencer Grand Voyage 12 Pax Intake Form
description: Welcome to your Dreams2Memories Travel Master Intake. To ensure seamless travel arrangements, visa processing, flight preferences, stateroom allocations, and dining reservations for your party of 12, please complete the required information below.

sections.section_title: SECTION 2 — Passenger Roster (12 Pax Legal Identifiers)

questions.title: Passenger Legal Names & Passports (Pax 1 through Pax 12)
questions.description: Please list Full Name (per Passport), Date of Birth (MM/DD/YYYY), Passport Number, Expiration Date, and Country of Issuance for each traveler.

questions.title: Stateroom Allocation Preference
questions.description: Indicate how the 12 travelers should be paired across staterooms/suites (e.g. Suite 1: Pax 1 & Pax 2).

questions.title: Frequent Flyer / Airline Loyalty Program Numbers
Pre-Cruise / Post-Cruise Land Stay Extension Interest
options: Undecided / Discuss with D2M Travel Architect

questions.title: Medical / Mobility Assistance Needs
questions.description: Wheelchair access, CPAP equipment, medication refrigeration, CPAP distilled water, etc.

questions.title: Special Occasion Celebrations During Voyage
questions.description: Birthdays, anniversaries, milestones occurring during the trip.

questions.title: Primary Emergency Contact (Not Traveling with Group)
questions.description: Full Name, Relationship, Phone Number, Email.

questions.title: Travel Protection Insurance Status
options: Include D2M Comprehensive Travel Protection Quote
Group will use private travel insurance
